title: CD Projekt Red 将在 Blizzard 的 Battle.net 发行《The Witcher 3: The Wild Hunt》
content:
CD Projekt Red to list The Witcher 3 on Blizzard's Battle.net
Business
News
CD Projekt Red to distribute The Witcher 3: The Wild Hunt on Blizzard's Battle.net
The remastered rendition of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt is coming to Battle.net, along with the new upcoming expansion and a Diablo IV collab.
Diego Argüello
,
Contributing Editor, News
,
GameDeveloper.com
August 26, 2026
1 Min Read
Image via CD Projekt Red
CD Projekt Red and Blizzard have entered a new business partnership, which starts with bringing
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Remastered
to Battle.net next month.
Announced
yesterday
by the respective
companies
, the remastered rendition of the acclaimed RPG, which releases on September 29, will be joined by the upcoming expansion,
Songs of the Past
, next year.
"Bringing these games to Battle.net is just the beginning of our partnership with Blizzard," reads the announcement by CD Projekt Red.
On Blizzard's side,
Diablo IV
will feature a themed cosmetic skin after Geralt of Rivia, protagonist of The Witcher series. This will be available for people who purchase the expansion via Blizzard's store.
CD Projekt Red is returning to
The Witcher 3
after years placing its attention on
Cyberpunk 2077
, which has
sold 40 million copies
since launching in December 2020. Despite the milestone, the company laid off nine developers early this month, which were working on a Witcher multiplayer game codenamed Project Sirius. Meanwhile, another nine have been invited to apply for roles on different projects.
Related:
Ubisoft debuts Player Council platform to expand early game development feedback
CD Projekt hasn't confirmed whether the partnership will also extend to
The Witcher IV
and the sequel to Cyberpunk 2077 in the future, which are
currently in development
. The companies are set to share more details about their newfound partnership at Blizzcon 2026.
